900001.title: Lone Pine
900001.extract:
Lone Pine is a small town in the Owens Valley of the Eastern Sierra, at the foot of Mount Whitney.

== See ==
=== Alabama Hills ===
Mobius Arch and the Arch Loop trail frame Mount Whitney at sunrise. Movie Road passes the rocks used in many westerns.
=== Museums ===
The Museum of Western Film History shows the area's film past.
